why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Install the extension or app Add the DataHive Chrome extension , or download the Android app from Google Play .
2 Step 2 : Sign up with your email Start from the Start earning page and register an account with your email address, then open the dashboard .
3 Step 3 : Keep it online Leave the extension or app running so it keeps earning.
4 Step 4 : Complete missions Open the missions page and pick the ones that suit you, such as audio recordings, the survey or the SOL staking mission. Each lists its own points amount.
